FAQ

Does enabling Fall Detection on Apple Watch auto-translate my China listing?

No. Fall Detection is on-device hard-fall sensing and wrist-tap behavior — it does not create or fill a Simplified Chinese localization row. Empty or English zh-Hans fields mean China buyers see en-US fallback even when your US listing mentions Detect Falls, wrist tap, or emergency call if no response.

How is this different from Crash Detection listing copy?

Crash Detection markets car crash sensors, collision triage, and automatic emergency call after a vehicle impact — 车祸检测, 碰撞检测, 严重车祸自动求救. Fall Detection marketing covers Apple Watch hard-fall sensing, wrist tap confirmation, and emergency call when the wearer does not respond — 跌倒检测, 检测跌倒, 严重跌倒, 手腕轻敲. A hard fall on the wrist is not a car crash.

How is this different from Emergency SOS listing copy?

Emergency SOS markets side-button or volume-button emergency call, auto-call countdown, and Emergency contacts on iPhone — 紧急SOS, 侧面按钮求救. Fall Detection marketing covers automatic hard-fall detection on Apple Watch and wrist-tap dismiss-or-call flows — 跌倒检测. The SOS call pipeline may fire after a fall, but side-button SOS setup is not the Fall Detection listing lead.

How is this different from Medical ID listing copy?

Medical ID marketing covers lock-screen emergency medical profile cards — blood type, allergies, medications, and emergency contacts — 医疗信息, 医疗急救卡. Fall Detection may share Medical ID during a fall alert, but that adjacent card is not the Fall Detection hero story. See the Medical ID listing guide for emergency medical profile marketing.

How is this different from Roadside Assistance via Satellite?

Roadside Assistance markets off-grid vehicle breakdown help — flat tire, out of fuel, tow request — 卫星道路救援, 卫星路边援助. Fall Detection marketing covers Apple Watch hard-fall alerts and emergency call if the wearer does not respond — 跌倒检测. Vehicle breakdown satellite messaging is not wrist fall sensing.
